title: Can Bellingham become England's superstar once more at the World Cup?
description: After tough love from England head coach Thomas Tuchel, Jude Bellingham's World Cup build-up points to a special talent who can be a key figure in their quest to win the World Cup.

title: McInnes replaces Rohl at Rangers - was decision no-brainer?
description: Derek McInnes says "it is a real honour" to be named Rangers manager after he replaces Danny Rohl in the Ibrox dugout.

title: How sweltering Scotland can handle World Cup heat
description: With Scotland's World Cup games expected to take place in temperatures of around 30C, Steve Clarke and his team will have to battle the conditions as well as Morocco and Brazil.

title: Extraordinary Messi makes more history in masterclass for the ages
description: Kylian Mbappe and Erling Haaland both enjoyed a fine start to the World Cup - but on a day packed with superstars, Lionel Messi still took top billing.

title: Fulham 'really like' two candidates to replace Silva
description: Fulham have two leading candidates in mind to take over from former manager Marco Silva, says the club's vice-chairman and director of football operations Tony Khan.

title: No stage too big - Haaland arrives in style at World Cup
description: Erling Haaland has made a habit of scoring debut goals in the big competitions. He did it in the Champions League, the Bundesliga and the Premier League. Now he has done it at the World Cup too.

title: Real Madrid sign Bernardo on free after Man City exit
description: Bernado Silva, who left Manchester City at the end of the season, links up with new Real Madrid manager Jose Mourinho.

title: Messi stays humble after hat-trick performance
description: Argentina captain Lionel Messi says equalling the record for World Cup goals "is an honour, but it is just a statistic".

title: England won't change style despite US heat - Tuchel
description: Thomas Tuchel says he is "not ready to adapt" England's playing style at the World Cup despite the heat - as it would "give up" the team's strengths.

title: Emotional Messi explains tears after Argentina goal
description: Lionel Messi was brought to tears after scoring the opening goal in Argentina's 3-0 win against Algeria because of a matter "completely unrelated to football".

title: 'Nearly men of Asian football' - Uzbekistan's rise to the World Cup
description: Uzbekistan are the first nation from Central Asia to qualify for the Fifa World Cup. Here is how they got to North America.

title: 'Magnificent' - Messi scores hat-trick to equal Klose scoring record
description: Lionel Messi scores a hat-trick to reach 16 World Cup goals, equalling Miroslav Klose's record.

title: Arnautovic on target as Austria beat spirited Jordan
description: Arnautovic scores a late penalty as Austria beat World Cup debutants Jordan 3-1 in Group J.

title: Highlights: Messi equals Klose scoring record with hat-trick against Algeria
description: Lionel Messi becomes the World Cup's joint-top all-time leading scorer with a hat-trick, as reigning champions Argentina begin their defence with a 3-0 win over Algeria.

title: Highlights: Haaland scores twice in Norway win over Iraq
description: Erling Haland scores two goals as Norway begin their World Cup 2026 campaign with a 4-1 win against Iraq.
